text: Marlo runs the ferry. She is twenty-two, she has crossed this water four thousand times, and nobody on the council has ever asked her a thing.
That night I was out late. I saw the lamp go dark. Twelve seconds. Then I saw the other one.
Low, by the water. Steady. And that boat turned toward it like it had been told to.
Two lights. One high, one low. Gus closed his eyes and saw the whole thing at once.
